output.text: {"notes":["The requested joint angles and angular velocities are joint-local quantities in rad and rad/s; angles are unwrapped right-hand angles.","The tip position is requested in the right-handed world frame, where x is forward, y is left, and z is up, in meters.","Both joints receive a constant 0.1902245357 N·m torque over [0,2.0); joint_1 additionally receives +0.5 N·m over the scheduled interval [0.5745,0.6745).","joint_limit_by_T is true if either joint reaches an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad by 2.0 s; contact onset is rearmed below 2.795 rad."]}
